summary: Upgrade by reviewing upgrade planning, downloading the installer, configuring the bundle inventory and running it. In 2.6 the controller API remains for compatibility, but manage organizations, teams and users through the platform gateway API; legacy API changes take up to 15 minutes to sync to other components.
questions: Should I use the controller API or gateway API for users in AAP 2.6?
